Oncologist, radiologist, specialist in ENT oncology

Main areas of specialisation

  • Benign growths of the larynx
  • Growths in the nasopharynx and oral cavity
  • Thyroid cancer
  • Cancer of the larynx
  • Cancer of the tonsils
  • Cancer of the trachea
  • Cancer of the tongue
  • Tumours of the salivary glands
  • Auditory nerve neuritis

Summary

Dr Orit Gotfeld is a highly qualified oncologist, radiologist and otolaryngologist with many years of clinical experience. She is a leading specialist in Israel in the diagnosis and treatment of cancers of the ear, nose and throat, including malignant tumours of the larynx, nasopharynx, thyroid gland and other organs of the head and neck.

Dr Gotfeld holds a senior post in the ENT department of the Sourasky (Ichilov) medical centre in Tel Aviv. She is known for her professionalism and her distinctive approach to treating patients with cancer.

Alongside her clinical practice, Dr Gotfeld is actively engaged in research. She is the author of numerous research publications on ENT oncology and presents regularly at international conferences and symposia.

Education and clinical experience

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation: otolaryngology
  • Leading specialist in ENT oncology, ENT department, Tel Aviv, Israel

Dr Gotfeld undertakes continuous training and professional development, studying the newest approaches and techniques in radiology and ENT oncology.

Research work

Dr Gotfeld is actively engaged in research. She is the author and co-author of numerous papers published in prestigious international medical journals. The subjects of her work include:

  • New approaches to treating tumours of the ENT organs
  • The effectiveness of modern radiotherapy techniques
  • Innovative methods of diagnosis in ENT oncology

She also takes part in clinical research on the treatment of head and neck tumours and shares her experience actively with the international medical community.

Membership of professional associations

  • Israel Society of Otolaryngology
  • Israeli and European societies of ENT oncology
  • Israel Radiological Association
  • International society of oncologists
  • Participant in international conferences and symposia on oncology

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Dr Orit Gotfeld has earned the respect of patients and colleagues through her deep knowledge, her many years of experience and her professionalism. Her work helps patients from around the world receive highly qualified medical care and improve their quality of life.

Professor Ram Eitan is one of the leading gynaecological oncologists, and hundreds of women seek an appointment with him. Over twenty years of clinical practice Professor Eitan has become a specialist of the highest category. He is one of the few doctors who operate with the da Vinci robotic system. Only the most experienced surgeons use this system, which makes it possible to perform highly complex operations while reducing every possible risk. Thanks to Ram Eitan, thousands of patients have been freed of their illness and, no less importantly, have kept the ability to have children.

Specialisation in the prevention and treatment of precancerous conditions

Professor Eitan also specialises in the prevention and treatment of precancerous conditions. He performs minimally invasive gynaecological operations on the lining of the uterus and on the ovaries using the da Vinci system, and every kind of operation on the cervix. He has thousands of successful operations to his name, including those using robotic technology. Eitan performs laparoscopic and endoscopic operations, including conisation for cancer of the uterus. This method allows women to preserve their fertility and later give birth to healthy children.

Human support during treatment

The professor is convinced that treatment calls not only for professionalism and precision but also for human support. By listening to patients, treating every case as unique, answering questions and easing fears, the doctor creates an atmosphere that helps treatment succeed.

Conditions the doctor treats

  • Adenocarcinoma of the uterus
  • Cervical dysplasia
  • Diseases of the ovaries
  • Treatment of vaginal cancer in Israel
  • Uterine polyp
  • Vulvar cancer
  • Cancer of the uterus
  • Cervical cancer
  • Ovarian cancer
  • Endometriosis
  • Cervical erosion
  • Ablation

Education and research

  • Ram Eitan took his medical degree at the faculty of health sciences of Ben-Gurion University in Beersheba, Israel.
  • Fellowship in the gynaecology department of the Shaare Zedek hospital in Jerusalem.
  • Fellowship at the Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York, USA.

Teaching and research

  • Principal investigator in many clinical trials, including multinational and retrospective studies.
  • Member of prestigious medical societies.

Summary

Dr Ran Talisman is a highly qualified plastic surgeon with enormous clinical experience and an impeccable reputation both in Israel and beyond. He specialises in reshaping the nose, ears, eyelids, breasts and other parts of the body. In some 20 years of active practice he has performed more than 7,000 plastic operations. Patients describe him as a gifted surgeon and an attentive specialist who helps people rid themselves of various imperfections and regain their confidence.

Dr Talisman uses the most advanced techniques in plastic and aesthetic surgery, which allow excellent results without risk or complications. He has developed innovative approaches to liposuction and to rejuvenating procedures, and has become one of the most sought-after specialists in body contouring and facial lifting.

Education and clinical experience

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University
  • Fellowships at the Assaf Harofeh and Hadassah clinics
  • Advanced training in the United States, with fellowships at leading American clinics under the world's best specialists

Academic experience

Dr Talisman is actively engaged in research, developing and introducing new techniques in facelifting, liposuction and other aesthetic procedures. He shares the results of his work regularly with colleagues at international conferences and symposia.

Membership of professional organisations

  • Israel Association of Plastic Surgeons
  • American Association of Plastic Surgeons
  • American Society for Aesthetic Plastic Surgery

Dr Riad Haddad is an outstanding Israeli surgeon with expertise in cancers of the digestive tract. His qualifications are confirmed by his status as a physician of the highest category and by his doctoral degree.

Dr Haddad is considered one of Israel's foremost surgeons in the treatment of the digestive system. His command of minimally invasive, laparoscopic and endoscopic methods allows him to deal successfully with tumours, including those that present particular difficulty.

After taking his basic medical degree in Israel, Riad Haddad developed his skills at major Israeli medical institutions and then continued his training in Canada, where he deepened his knowledge of cancer surgery. On returning home he was invited to head departments at well-known Israeli medical centres.

Dr Haddad currently heads a department specialising in diseases of the liver, pancreas and gall bladder at one of the country's leading hospitals.

One of the key areas of his work is the use of adjuvant and neoadjuvant chemotherapy, aimed at slowing the growth of tumours or destroying them altogether, and at preventing metastasis.

Over his years in practice Dr Haddad has successfully helped thousands of patients facing cancer, achieving remission even in difficult forms of the disease.

Dr Haddad shares his experience actively with future specialists, teaching clinical surgery at Tel Aviv University. His expert opinion is sought at many international conferences and symposia. He is also the author of more than 60 papers in professional journals.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of Medicine, Technion, Haifa, Israel
  • Fellowship at the Carmel medical centre, Haifa, Israel
  • Specialisation in general surgery at Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in cancers of the digestive tract and liver at the university medical centre in Toronto, Canada

Summary
Dr Roy Tal is a leading Israeli dermatologist with extensive clinical and research experience. Throughout his career he has been actively engaged in the diagnosis and treatment of skin conditions, specialising in the early detection of melanoma, in dermoscopy and in the treatment of psoriasis.

Dr Tal takes part in international multicentre clinical trials and publishes his research actively. In particular, he is the author of papers for the Journal of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (JEADV) and of the study «Psoriasis and cardiovascular risk factors». His professional experience and his publications make him a sought-after specialist not only in Israel but beyond it.

Dr Roy Tal works actively with leading medical institutions in Israel, where he treats patients and carries out research in dermatology.

Education

  • 2006: Doctor of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel
  • 2001: Bachelor of Medical Sciences with distinction, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel
  • 1999: Bachelor of Biological Sciences, Tel Aviv University, Israel

Clinical experience

  • 2014 to the present: Dermatologist at the Maccabi health fund, Israel
  • 2012 to the present: Dermatologist at Clalit, Israel's largest and oldest health fund
  • 2012 to the present: Specialist at the pigmented lesion clinic, dermatology department, Rabin Medical Centre, Petah Tikva, Israel

Fellowships and advanced training

  • 2008-2012: Registrar in dermatology, Rabin Medical Centre, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • 2007-2008: Registrar in internal medicine, Chaim Sheba Medical Centre (Tel HaShomer), Ramat Gan
  • 2009: Course in statistics for medical research, Rabin Medical Centre, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • 2010: Course in good clinical practice (GCP)

Research and teaching

  • Author of research papers, including publications for JEADV
  • Researcher in cardiovascular risk factors in patients with psoriasis
  • Active participant in international conferences and scientific forums

Membership of professional associations

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Society of Dermatology and Venereology
  • International Dermoscopy Society

Summary

Dr Ronit Elhasid is a highly qualified paediatrician and haemato-oncologist with more than 30 years of experience. She has more than 50 professional publications and some 40 presentations at scientific conferences to her name. Her experience and knowledge make her a leading specialist in her field, providing reliable care and support to children and their families in the most difficult cases.
